bad_examples.name: process_refund
bad_examples.description: Process a refund for an order

good_examples.name: get_customer
good_examples.description: Look up a customer's profile by email address or customer UUID. Returns name, email, order history summary, and account status. Use this BEFORE lookup_order when the customer provides an email instead of an order ID. Returns empty object (not error) if no customer found

customer_id.description: Customer UUID (e.g. 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000). Not to be confused with order ID

good_examples.name: lookup_order
good_examples.description: Look up an order by order ID. Returns order details including customer information, items purchased, shipping address, and order status. Use this AFTER get_customer when the customer provides an order ID instead of an email address. Returns empty object (not error) if no order is found

order_id.description: Order ID (e.g. 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000). Not to be confused with order number

good_examples.name: check_product_availability
good_examples.description: Check if a product is currently available for purchase. Use when a customer asks about product availability or stock status.

product_id.description: Product ID (e.g. 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000). Not to be confused with product sku

good_examples.name: process_refund
good_examples.description: Process a refund for an order. Returns the updated order details including customer information, items purchased, shipping address, and order status. This action is irreversible. Only call after confirming the order exists via lookup_order and verifying refund eligibility

order_id.description: Order ID (e.g. 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000). Not to be confused with order number

refund_amount.description: Refund amount (e.g. 29.99). Use the full order total for a complete refund

reason.description: Reason for refund (e.g. 'wrong size', 'damaged item', 'customer changed mind')
